### ECK Platform Overview
Operator, custom resource, and Kubernetes state from an `eck-diagnostics` bundle. Filter by `diagnostic.id`; the included Elasticsearch diagnostics join on `diagnostic.parent_id` and `kubernetes.pod.name` = `node.name`.
